## Pre-Review Checklist
- [ ] Changes are isolated on a feature branch (not pushed directly to `main`)
- [ ] Commits are atomic with clear, descriptive messages
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or `.env` files are included in the diff
- [ ] Self-reviewed the diff (`git diff main...HEAD`) before requesting review
